notes: Seed URL works over https; all results are on page/sutton.Elections. No Clarity site (elections.json 404). Server Last-Modified values differ by file and match scan times, so upload times are usable. Each target election has one election-night unofficial county-total summary (posted quickly after the first count; Sutton has 4 precincts) and later official results; no unofficial precinct reports. The runoff PDF CreationDate (01:11 UTC) is later than its Last-Modified (00:15 UTC), so the scanner clock is not reliable; printed footers and Last-Modified agree on election night. Official result files were not opened (post-canvass by title).
tag_rationale: All three elections are LATER by check 2 (only county totals on election night, precinct numbers only in official results if at all), so the tag is COUNTY_ONLY_PRECINCT_AT_CANVASS; confidence med because each night report has a printed run time and an election-night upload time.
